title: Asked by vg-paradigms: CI by hand and on release tags; deny.yml from the baseline (rules ci.on-demand, rust.ci-reads-toolchain)
body:
CI by hand and on release tags; deny.yml from the baseline (rules ci.on-demand, rust.ci-reads-toolchain) (graft:01a19343-7ac2..5db4, from vg-paradigms)

What was needed:
- vg-paradigms: (1) .github/workflows/ci.yml runs on every `push:` to any branch. Make it `workflow_dispatch:`, `pull_request:` and `push: tags: [...]` on sylva's release tags: it's published on crates.io and others build on its releases, so the rule runs CI on those tags. (2) .github/workflows/deny.yml installs dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable beside rust-toolchain.toml, and runs on every push. Taking baseline release 2026.10.7 and running `tend baseline render --write` replaces it with the rust profile's copy, which fixes both.

Answer (done): Done as your 2026-10-31 update asks, merged into sylva's main: .github/workflows/ (ci.yml, deny.yml) removed, and what only CI ran is now declared checks (proposal 01a1ed13-d166, accepted). Every commit: clippy and tests with all features, tests and clippy without std. Before a push: clippy and tests with default features; wasm32 builds without std, plain and with serde. Before a release: clippy with each feature alone (serde, log, sign, sqlite, crypt, knowledge, ts), cargo deny (advisories, bans, sources), and a blocking release gate that every test passes. The per-feature check caught a real bug on its first run (crypt alone left two sqlite-only imports unused; fixed in fb7a148). deny.toml's header now says it runs before a release. The baseline render that took out deny.yml was taken too.
